svg.text: Figure 5 · Peak-Hour Interval Width as a Joint Function of Design Dials
Width (kW) at Summer typical-day peak hour, swept over participation-interval width and peak-period tariff η; iso-width contours overlaid
Each cell reports the proposed-method 24-h interval width at the Summer-typical-day peak hour, in kW, as both design dials are swept independently. Thin black iso-width curves
overlay the heat map and turn it into a usable design chart: for any target interval width, the corresponding curve traces the locus of (τ-width, η_peak) pairs that achieve it. The
three labelled circles mark the typical-day operating points; their relative position confirms that tariff η carries the larger leverage.
